WITH budget_event AS (
  SELECT 
    b.budget_id,
    b.category,
    b.spent,
    b.remaining,
    b.amount,
    e.type as event_type
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
category_level AS (
  SELECT 
    event_type,
    category,
    AVG(amount - spent) as category_avg_minus_spent
  FROM budget_event
  GROUP BY event_type, category
),
event_type_level AS (
  SELECT 
    be.event_type,
    AVG(be.remaining) as avg_remaining,
    AVG(cl.category_avg_minus_spent) as avg_budget_minus_spent
  FROM budget_event be
  LEFT JOIN category_level cl ON be.event_type = cl.event_type AND be.category = cl.category
  GROUP BY be.event_type
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_budget_minus_spent) as overall_avg
  FROM event_type_level
  WHERE avg_budget_minus_spent IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_event_types AS (
  SELECT 
    etl.event_type,
    etl.avg_remaining,
    etl.avg_budget_minus_spent,
    os.overall_avg
  FROM event_type_level etl
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE os.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND etl.avg_budget_minus_spent > os.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_remaining) as avg_budget_remaining,
  AVG(avg_budget_minus_spent) as avg_amount_minus_spent,
  AVG(avg_budget_minus_spent - overall_avg) as avg_diff_from_overall
FROM filtered_event_types
